source_snapshot.procedure: Verify OS boot media and health, issue sudo reboot, verify readiness, run Post-Boot Stress and Basic Health, capture dmesg/RAS, repeat for 100 cycles.
source_snapshot.criteria: Calls completion a power cycle, says 100 cycles recommended, and requires no lock/MCE/kernel error/health mismatch/Post-Boot failure.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL one insecure reboot only; omits 100-cycle orchestration and complete per-cycle acceptance.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; transition class, required count and bounded controller remained pending.

old_problem: Procedure performs warm OS reboot but Criteria says power cycle; the source gives no precedence or proof of equivalence. `Repeat ... for 100 cycles` conflicts with `100 cycles are recommended`. DeepSeek executes only one reboot and cannot prove unique boots, full health/stress/RAS coverage or safe recovery.
disposition_reason: Retain Pending and Source Conflict. ED-06/ED-14/ED-18/ED-19 require cycle classes and formal duration/count to remain distinct; neither technical standards nor EDs select between the source's contradictory literals. A safe draft preserves both without execution and fully defines boot identity, readiness, Basic Health, Post-Boot Stress, logs/RAS, stop-on-first-anomaly and recovery once the owner selects transition and count.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2067, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2068 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00022-V002 / dd30a7ff18ab4a64 was directly read from XLSX and locked queue.
`sudo reboot` does not remove power; a power cycle has distinct transition evidence and recovery, so final OS Ready cannot make them equivalent.
The body commands 100 repetitions while Criteria calls 100 recommended; accepted count must be signed before execution and a shorter smoke cannot satisfy 100-cycle coverage.
Each cycle needs a new persistent boot identity, bounded console/OS/service/GPU readiness and complete Basic Health/Post-Boot/RAS/kernel/BMC evidence before advancing.
Clearing logs and grep-only absence would destroy or omit evidence; preserve boot-scoped deltas and stop at first anomaly without retry.
No login, reboot, power cycle, health test, log clear, recovery, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Owner-selected 100-cycle-class reboot endurance with per-cycle boot and health reconciliation — GATE-CLOSED DRAFT
test_case.purpose: After authoritative transition and count selection, prove every required cycle reaches a unique healthy boot with unchanged boot media, complete AMD GPU/service readiness, passing Post-Boot Stress and Basic Health, and no new lock/MCE/RAS/kernel/BMC fault.
required_package: Signed selection of warm OS reboot or separately specified power-cycle class and accepted cycle count
Default OS boot-media identity, unique boot-ID, console/OS/service/GPU readiness and timeout rules
Exact Basic Health and Post-Boot Stress recipes, versions and comparison baselines
Kernel/journal/RAS/EDAC/MCE/BMC/SEL/GPU error policy and per-cycle storage
Approved controller, workload drain, maintenance authorization, duplicate prevention and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED — DO NOT EXECUTE until transition and count are signed. After unlock, preserve baseline and for each numbered cycle issue exactly one approved transition, independently observe its required state sequence, prove a new boot ID plus console/OS/service/GPU readiness, run exact Post-Boot Stress and Basic Health, and seal complete kernel/journal/RAS/EDAC/BMC evidence before continuing. Halt on any incomplete/failed cycle; no log clear, fixed-sleep proof, substitution or retry.
test_case.expected_result: After unlock, every required numbered cycle completes the selected transition, produces a unique boot and full readiness, preserves expected boot media/configuration and passes complete stress/health/error criteria with no lock, MCE, mismatch or disallowed delta.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS is possible while transition class or accepted count is unresolved. Then PASS requires all required unique cycles and every per-cycle oracle. FAIL on wrong transition, duplicate/skipped/incomplete cycle, boot/readiness/GPU/stress/health failure, lock/MCE/error or evidence gap. Command dispatch and final reachability alone cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until transition class, count and recovery are signed.
Drain workloads and validate independent console/power recovery before cycle one.
Seal complete evidence for each cycle and stop on the first anomaly.
Never automatically retry, add cycles, clear logs or substitute warm reboot for power cycle.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and signed transition/count disposition
Numbered cycle ledger with request, transition, unique boot ID and readiness milestones
Complete per-cycle stress/health/error artifacts and reconciliation
Final health, no-clear/no-substitution/no-retry audit, recovery and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On transition, boot, controller, GPU/service, stress, health, log or RAS anomaly, halt and seal the first-failure cycle. Do not issue another transition. Use only the approved independent recovery path and require owner disposition before continuation.
